documents.name: AI Addendum
documents.description: Addendum that layers AI-specific terms onto an existing agreement, covering use of AI services, customer data handling, model training restrictions, and allocation of responsibility for AI output.

fields.label: Improvement Restrictions
fields.ask: Any limits on using the customer's data to improve the service?

fields.ask: What may that data be used to train models for?

documents.limitation: An AI Addendum attaches to an existing agreement rather than standing on its own. Name the agreement it supplements and the addendum will reference it.
